## Purpose

What Astro data problem, Experiment change, or repository change does this pull request address?

## How to run it

Commands a reviewer should use to install, run, build, and check the work.

## Included sample

What fixture, sample data, or walkthrough does the change include so a reviewer can observe the result?

## Observations

What did you learn from running the work? Record concrete outcomes, not only intentions.

## Remaining limitations

What still fails, remains out of scope, or should not be mistaken for a finished product?
